With two lists, this creates a list of every element in both lists that is not in the other list.

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：任意 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有实体的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Any (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of all entities near the position.

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：动物 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有动物的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Animal (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of animals near the position.

names.ja_jp: 地帯の蒸溜: アイテム

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：物品 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有掉落的物品的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Item (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of dropped items near the position.

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：生物 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有生物的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Living (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of living creatures near the position.

names.ja_jp: 地帯の蒸溜: モンスター

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：怪物 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有怪物的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Monster (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of monsters near the position.

names.ja_jp: 地帯の蒸溜: 非動物

zh_cn.title: 区域之馏化：非动物 (vector, number → list)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有非动物实体的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Dstl.: Non-Animal (vector, number → list)
en_us.text: Take a position and maximum distance on the stack, and combine them into a list of non-animal entities near the position.

为副手中的物品永久签上我的名字，以我的 染色剂 为颜色。对我已签过名的物品再次签名，会将我的签名移至首位。
因为签名的刻印极深， 清除物品 无法去除签名，而是需要专用的法术来抹除。
不过，能完成这项任务的法术本身就可以清空 核心 的内容物，以及 施法物品 的 咒术 和 媒质 。也许这也算是长处：我的 咒法学 赠礼若带有我的亲笔签名，就表明没人做过手脚。

Because an autograph is strongly imprinted on an item, Erase Item is insufficient to remove it; a specialized spell is required to extripate autographs.
However, a spell capable of doing by its very nature will also destroy a Focus 's contents or a casting device 's Hex and media . Perhaps that is for the better—my autographed Hexcasting gifts can be uniquely assured to be untampered.

zh_cn.title: 构筑烟花 (vec, vec, num, num, list of vec, list of vec, bool, bool →)
zh_cn.text:
根据我 详细 给定的参数构筑一道烟花。这是我迄今为止发现的最复杂的法术之一。消耗量与其他烟花法术一致。
基础理论
前两个参数分别是位置和速度。第三个参数决定其飞行时间，需是 1 与 3 之间的数。可以认为是加入烟花火箭的 火药 份数。
剩余的参数可看作 虚拟烟火之星 的各特征。
形状效果
第四个参数控制烟花的形状，需是 0 与 4 之间的数，包含两端。 - 0 对应简单的小型球状效果。 - 1 对应大型球状效果。 - 2 对应星形效果。 - 3 对应大型苦力怕状效果。 - 4 对应喷发状效果。
颜色
第五和第六个参数是代表颜色的向量组成的列表。第一个列表控制烟花的初始颜色，第二个列表控制烟花消散时的渐变颜色。第一列表中需至少含有一个向量，第二个列表可以留空。
向量各分量为 0 到 1 的数，分别对应不同强度的红、绿、蓝。
附加效果
第七个参数控制烟花粒子是否闪烁，相当于加入荧石与否。
第八个参数控制烟花粒子是否留下踪迹，相当于加入钻石与否。

en_us.title: Conjure Firework (vec, vec, num, num, list of vec, list of vec, bool, bool →)
en_us.text:
Conjures a firework of my exact specifications. Costs about one Amethyst Shard
Basic Theory
The first two parameters of the spell are simple position and velocity. The third parameter dictates flight duration as a number from 1 to 3. I can imagine it as being the amount of Gunpowder I would add to a firework rocket.
The remaining parameters can be imagined as specifications for a virtual firework star.
Shape
The fourth parameter controls the shape of the explosion, based off a number 0 to 4 inclusive. - 0 is a simple, small ball-shaped explosion. - 1 is a large ball-shaped explosion. - 2 is a star-shaped explosion. - 3 is a large creeper face-shaped explosion. - 4 is a conic burst.
Colors
The fifth and sixth parameters are lists of vectors, representing colors. The first list maps to the colors of the initial explosions, while the second maps to the colors that the particles fade into. There must be at least one vector specified for the first list, but the second list may be empty.
The vector components represent redness, greenness, and blueness on a scale of 0 to 1 respectively.
Special Effects
The seventh parameter controls whether the particles of the firework flicker, as if adding glowstone to the virtual Firework Star .
The eighth parameter controls whether the particles of the firework leave trails, as if adding a diamond to the virtual Firework Star .

zh_cn.text:
使用所给 iota 在给定位置构筑一枚 咒术星爆糖 。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。可能招致“违犯他人”事故。
取出一个 iota，再在周围包裹 媒质 ，直至它具备物理形态，就得到了可食用的 咒术星爆糖 。食用时，这种糖会将其中的 iota 压入食用者的栈。如果我想要交易代表我的 iota，它应该会很有用。如果栈中有未闭合的 内省 ，则其会进入所构造的列表。

en_us.title: Conjure Hexburst (vector, any →)
en_us.text:
Conjures a Hexburst of the given iota at the location. Costs about half of an Amethyst Dust and is subject to the Transgress Others mishap.
Hexbursts are an iota wrapped in layers of media around it. When I eat one, the inscribed iota is immediately pushed to my Staff 's stack. I shall find them useful if I ever want to trade my entity reference. If my stack has an unclosed Introspection , the iota appears in the forming list.

zh_cn.title: 构筑咒力多滋 (vector, list of patterns →)
zh_cn.text:
在给定位置构筑一片 咒力多滋 。消耗大约 2 个 紫水晶粉 。可能招致“违犯他人”事故。
咒力多滋 是一种三角形的酥脆零食。食用时会立即施放其中 咒术 ；它使用的是 法杖 栈，而非和普通 施法物品 那样使用独立的栈。它大概很适合射线追踪之类的简单操作集合，也方便我与他人分享我设计的 咒术 。如果食用者的栈存在未闭合的 内省 ，其中咒术便不会施放，以此保障他人使用的安全。

en_us.title: Conjure Hextito (vector, list of patterns →)
en_us.text:
Conjures a Hextito of the given Hex at the location. Costs about half of an Amethyst Dust and is subject to the Transgress Others mishap.
When I eat a Hextito , I am immediately compelled to cast the inscribed Hex , with my Staff 's stack unlike a regular casting device . I shall find them useful to quickly cast repeated actions like raycasts or to give out limited uses of a Hex . If a stack has an unclosed Introspection , the Hextito will not cast, making it quite safe to hand out.

这类法术据信极难施放，但也极为强力。记载它们的文献极为 少见 （据称理由充分）。这也许只是某些消亡的老古董口中的胡言乱语，不过——它们只是简单的图案罢了。
试试看又能出什么错呢？

en_us.text:
Conjures a mesh with the location and pushes the entity to the stack. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
The spells catalogued here are purported to be of legendary difficulty and power. They seem to have been recorded only sparsely (for good reason, the texts claim). It's probably just the ramblings of extinct traditionalists, though -- a pattern's a pattern.
What could possibly go wrong?

zh_cn.text:
按照所给 iota、位置、朝向构筑视斑。消耗极少量 媒质 。压入视斑 iota。
I can read a display iota from it and write any iota I'd wish to change its image after conjuration for free.
Specks only remember the textual information of the iota they contain at the moment of writing and it is thus impossible to extract a functional copy of the original iota from one. I need not worry about leaving Specks with my Name around.

en_us.title: Conjure Speck (any, vector, vector → entity)
en_us.text:
Conjures a speck of the iota with the given position and rotation. Costs a negligible amount of media . Pushes the entity to the stack.
I can read a display iota from it and write any iota I'd wish to change its image after conjuration for free.
Specks only remember the textual information of the iota they contain at the moment of writing and it is thus impossible to extract a functional copy of the original iota from one. I need not worry about leaving Specks with my Name around.

en_us.text:

Regardless of amount of breath restored, this spell costs exactly the same so I should wait as long as I safely can before casting this spell. I will find it useful while diving, being teleported into a block, or even keeping sea creatures alive on land.
The best way to observe a fish is to become a fish.

zh_cn.title: 构筑火球 (vector → entity)
zh_cn.text:
构筑一个易爆的火球， 敲击可发射 。消耗大约 3 个 紫水晶粉 。
还有其他法术也可以构筑弹射物；但它们太过复杂，超出了此章范畴。它们在对应的专论章节内。
魔法飞弹 是一类快捷多用的标准紫水晶矛，可使用任意速度发射。
还可在战斗中 善用烟花 。
此外，还有 一个法术 能够发射药水和箭。

en_us.title: Conjure Fireball (vector → entity)
en_us.text:
Conjures an explosive fireball that can be percussively propelled . Costs about three Amethyst Dust .
There exist other spells too complex to be given justice in this chapter—I have dedicated other chapters to them.
Magic Missile is a standard quick and versatile spear of amethyst that can be produced and fired at arbitrary speed.
I can also utilize fireworks for battle.
Finally, a certain spell allows the ability to fire potions and arrows.

zh_cn.title: 卓越闪现 (vector →)
zh_cn.text:
将我传送最多 128 格，传送目的以我的位置和朝向为参照。消耗大约 2 个 紫水晶粉 。
向量 (0, 0, 1) 会往 我面朝的方向 传送 1 格。向量 (0, 1, 0) 会往 我头顶的法向 传送 1 格。向量 (0, 1, 10) 会往我面朝方向传送 10 格，再往头顶法向传送 1 格。向量 (1, 0, 0) 会往我的右侧传送 1 格。
我感到三根数轴精准地穿过我头颅的六面。在刹那之间，我仿佛被尖桩扎穿——吊在空中——然后随我先前的指示，我被猛烈地拽动——就沿着那些几何轴——移动如同在瞬间完成。
我肯定已经不是世界的一部分了——因为我穿了墙，而且没有留下哪怕一丁点痕迹。

en_us.title: Greater Blink (vector →)
en_us.text:
Teleports me up to 128 blocks away, relative to my position and rotation. Costs about two Amethyst Dust .
A vector of (0, 0, 1) would teleport me one block in the direction I'm facing . A vector of (0, 1, 0) would teleport me one block up from the top of my head . A vector of (0, 1, 10) would teleport me ten blocks forward in the direction I'm facing and one block upwards from the top of my head. A vector of (1, 0, 0) teleports me one block to my right.
I felt three numerical axes perfectly pierce all six faces of my head. For a moment, I was skewered—suspended midair—and then at my specifications, I was violently dragged along the geometrical scaffolds at speeds indistinguishable from instantaneousness.
I must have been no longer a part of the world, for I was yanked through walls without causing even the smallest disturbance.

记载有这项技术的古代文本还写有其他琐事。曾经的 咒术师 唤咒时不用 咒术 ，而是在某种集会或集体仪式中挥动手臂合唱。也有人曾试验过，是否有法术能将 咒术 蚀刻入 村民 ，以给予他们操控 媒质 的手段。但这些试验的结果从未见诸文献，抑或是已经散佚殆尽。

The ancient texts I have learned this technique from reveals many other interesting trifles: Hexcasters used to perform evocation without any a Hex , as a greeting or group ritual by waving their arms and chanting in unison. Experiments have also been done to see if a villager could be granted the ability to shift media but the results of those experiments were either never documented or have been lost to time.

en_us.title: Mage Mouth (entity →)
en_us.text: Makes me eat an item, nourishing me or applying status effects to me. Costs about one Amethyst Dust and mishaps if the item is not edible.

zh_cn.title: 魔法飞弹 (vector, vector →)
zh_cn.text:
构筑一小片紫水晶，对命中目标固定造成 1 颗心的伤害，同时强令目标退后。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
弹射物有几项特别的性质。它在存在大约 10 秒后会自动消失，击中实体或方块后会碎裂。它会穿过所有形式的盔甲和保护，也不受重力和水的影响。
晶莹闪亮的弹射物，不算很强，但非常迷人……
第一个向量是构筑的位置，其性质相当奇妙：怪不得大多数 咒术师 都只选择在面前构筑它们。这一参数以我的头部位置为原点，我 面朝的方向 是 Z 轴正向， 头顶向上的方向 是 Y 轴正向，头部向右的方向是 X 轴正向。平常使用时，零向量对应在我的头颅内部构筑，形如 (0, 0, n) 的向量则会在我面前 n 格处构筑。
第二个向量是速率。它好在比第一参数简单不少——就是简单的偏移向量，与 驱动 接受的向量类似。而与 驱动 不同的是，本法术的向量没有模长限制，也不会因模长增加而增大消耗。
魔法飞弹 与 箭 的不同之处在于，前者不会因为飞行速度快而造成更多伤害。飞弹还会产生一种奇怪的击退效果，无视实体的质量和弹射物的速度。

en_us.title: Magic Missile (vector, vector →)
en_us.text:
Conjures a small silver of amethyst that always deals a full heart of damage and forces the target backwards. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
The projectile has a few interesting properties. It automatically disappears after roughly ten seconds or shatters upon hitting an entity or block. It pierces all forms of armor and protection. It is also unaffected by gravity and water drag.
A weak but enchanting sparkling projectile.
The first vector is conjuration location and is quite esoteric: no wonder most Hexcasters conjure it in front of them. The basic gist is a vector, where my head's position is the origin, my facing is the Z+ axis, the vector pointing up from my head is the Y+ axis, and the vector from my head pointing rightwards is the X+ axis. For basic purposes, the zero vector conjures it inside my head and a vector resembling (0, 0, n) conjures it n blocks in front of me.
The second vector is velocity and thankfully much less complicated. It is a simple offset vector, similar to the one that Impulse takes in. Unlike Impulse though, this vector can be of arbitrary magnitude without incurring additional costs.
Unlike Arrows though, Magic Missiles will not increase in damage simply by travelling faster. They also apply an odd knockback effect that ignores the entity's mass or the projectile's speed.

zh_cn.text: 让方块和 黏液块 一样弹性十足。无论我是否潜行都会把我弹起来。很有趣！

zh_cn.title: 戏法 (entity/vector →)
zh_cn.text:
产生一类小型魔法效果，这种效果与目标的性质和功能基本一致。消耗大约 1/10 个 紫水晶粉 。
我在此整理了一份此法术的功效列表，不保证完备：打开或关闭各种材质的栅栏门、活板门、门；拨动拉杆，按压按钮；压下或松开压力板；熄灭各类火；点燃或熄灭蜡烛、蛋糕上的蜡烛、营火；在可引燃灵魂火的方块上点火；敲钟；为木材去皮；雕刻南瓜；使音符盒发出声音；将泥巴烤干为黏土；打开或关闭红石灯；
触发发射器和投掷器；将大部分土壤方块变为土径，将土径变为耕地；消耗炼药锅的内容物；更改红石中继器、红石比较器、阳光探测器的状态；触发或解除 TNT 和苦力怕的爆炸；为绵羊剪毛；装上或卸下盔甲架的手臂；使得鱿鱼喷墨；使得熊猫打喷嚏；去除雪傀儡的头套；令河豚膨胀；从蜂巢和蜂箱中取出蜜脾；以及触发某种 咒法学 的“宏伟之作”。
add about five seconds of fuel for the various types of furnaces; transform the variants of froglights, and activates some grand Hexcasting work.

en_us.text: Transforms the world into a thin outline of black and white. Possibly useful for identifying subtle contrasts.

zh_cn.title: 辨识重点
zh_cn.text: 让我只能看见最为重要的事物……

en_us.title: Identify Importance
en_us.text: Transforms my vision to perceive only the most important things...

zh_cn.title: 穿透黑暗
zh_cn.text: 大幅改善我在暗处的视野，不过光照会同时变得极为刺眼。

en_us.title: Pierce Darkness
en_us.text: Greatly augments my ability to see in the dark, although the light resultingly becomes extremely blinding.

zh_cn.title: 分裂视野
zh_cn.text: 将我的视野分裂为多个小块，和蜘蛛的视野大概差不多。不太清楚为什么这么做能让我看得更清晰……

en_us.title: Split Vision
en_us.text: Splits my vision into multiple sections, similar to what a spider might see. I am unsure whether it actually grants me more vision...

zh_cn.title: 广播视野
zh_cn.text: 令我的视野中出现奇怪的线条，且视野的中心“向我”突出。大概是有所致敬……

en_us.title: Broadcast Vision
en_us.text: Alters my vision to contain strange lines and make objects towards the center of my vision bulge towards me. Seems to be in reference to something...

zh_cn.title: 喊出思维 (any →)
zh_cn.text: 在屏幕中央显示 iota。这么做会阻碍视野，消散也要时间，因此不应经常使用。

en_us.title: Shout Thought (any →)
en_us.text: Grandly flashes an iota across my vision. It seems to take some time to fade in so it can not be cast as frequently as its less intrusive sibling.

zh_cn.title: 图案制作师之馏化 (pattern, number → pattern)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个图案和一个数，返回同外形不同笔顺的图案。我找到的一些笔记中称古代的 咒术师 会把这些图案用在某种 庞大的图书馆 中。

en_us.title: Glyphmaker's Dstl. (pattern, number → pattern)
en_us.text: Uses the number to shuffle the pattern into one of the same shape, but different stroke order. My notes hint that ancient Hexcasters used this for some grand library .

zh_cn.title: 缩放视斑 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text:
更改视斑的大小，接受 0 与 10 之间的数。此数表示以格计的大小，默认为 0。
Among specklikes, there exist a subset of them called figures . They can generally be distinguished by being more abstract than traditional specklikes, drawing lines and shapes rather than text or realistic.
Due to their abstractness, they have various properties that can be customized. Relevant patterns are on the following pages.

en_us.title: Resize Specklike (entity, number →)
en_us.text:
Scales a specklike from zero to ten times its original size.
Among specklikes, there exist a subset of them called figures . They can generally be distinguished by being more abstract than traditional specklikes, drawing lines and shapes rather than text or realistic.
Due to their abstractness, they have various properties that can be customized. Relevant patterns are on the following pages.

zh_cn.title: 花招 (item entity/vector →)
zh_cn.text:
表演一次魔法花招，将物品偷来放入魔袋，或是将魔袋中的物品扔出来。消耗大约 1/4 个 紫水晶粉 。
传入向量时：将魔袋中的物品投放到对应位置。传入物品实体时：若魔袋为空，将其放入魔袋；若不为空，交换魔袋内容物和所给物品。
使用手法时如果不能将视线一直保持在观众身上，那最好还是再去练练。

en_us.title: Sleight (item entity/vector →)
en_us.text:
Performs an act of magical sleight of hand to steal items into my wristpocket or expel my wristpocket back into the world. Costs about a fourth of one Amethyst Dust .
If given a vector, it conjures my wristpocketed item at that vector. If given an item entity, my wristpocket either pulls in or swaps with the item, depending on whether it is empty.
If your sleight of hand causes you to break eye contact with your audience, it is too advanced for your skill level.

zh_cn.title: 潜行之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 压入我按下 潜行 键的时间，以 1/20 秒计，如果未按下则返回 -1。

en_us.title: Stealthy Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes how many twentieths of a second I've been intending to Sneak , or -1 if I am not.

zh_cn.title: 构筑尖刺 (vector, vector, number →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个非空气位置，一个轴向向量，按秒延迟最长 10 秒后，在给定位置构筑一个尖刺。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
尖刺在造成伤害前会准备大约半秒，且会在缓慢缩回前造成高达三颗心的伤害。若在已经触发尖刺的位置重复施放法术，则不会有任何效果。尖刺同时会向构筑的方向击退目标。

en_us.title: Conjure Spike (vector, vector, number →)
en_us.text:
Takes a non-air position, an axis vector, and a delay in seconds up to ten seconds long and conjures a spike at that location. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
Each spike takes about a half second to strike and deal a hefty three full hearts of damage before slowly sinking back into the ground. If I cast this spell where a spike has not yet disappeared, it will do nothing. Spikes will also throw back targets in the direction they were conjured.

zh_cn.title: 内化染色剂，第二型 (pigment →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个染色剂 iota 并内化它。

en_us.title: Internalize Pigment II (pigment →)
en_us.text: Internalizes a pigment iota.

zh_cn.title: 增粗视斑 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text: 更改图案视斑笔触的粗细，接受 0 与 10 之间的数。此数表示以 1/20 格计的大小，默认为 0。

en_us.title: Thicken Speck (entity, number →)
en_us.text: Changes the thickness of a figure from one to ten, representing twentieths of a block. What this entails varies between figure types but is generally intuitive.

zh_cn.title: 染色剂之纯化 (dye/entity → pigment)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个有色染料 iota，并转换为染色剂；接受一个人类并返回其染色剂；或是接受一个内含染色剂的物品，并返回其染色剂。

en_us.title: Pigment Purification (dye/entity → pigment)
en_us.text: Takes a colored dye iota and transforms it into a pigment, takes a person and returns their pigment, or takes an item containing a pigment and returns its pigment.

zh_cn.title: 藏入魔袋
zh_cn.text:
此法术会令另一只手中的物品组消失；也可重新让其出现，如果手中已经持有物品则会交换。消耗大约 1/8 个 紫水晶粉 。
虽然物品已经消失，而且是消失到几乎无法被探测，魔袋中物品的某些功能依然能够运作。
我听说某些 图腾 可在魔袋内运作。魔袋中的 媒质之瓶 也仍能为 咒术 提供媒质。

en_us.title: Wristpocket
en_us.text:
This spell vanishes the stack of items in my other hand, or conjures it back, swapping if my other hand is holding something. Costs about a eighth of one Amethyst Dust .
While the items disappear from reality in almost all measurable aspects, certain items' effects can still function even when hidden in the wristpocket.
I hear of certain Totems that still function within the wristpocket. Phials also can still provide for my Hexes within the wristpocket.

zh_cn.title: 魔袋之精思 (→ item)
zh_cn.text: 返回魔袋中的物品，如果魔袋为空则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Wristpocket Reflection (→ item)
en_us.text: Returns the item in my wristpocket, or Null if it is empty.

zh_cn.title: 图书管理员之策略 (vector, pattern, any →)
zh_cn.text: 以图案键向 阿卡夏书架 写入 iota。

en_us.title: Librarian's Gambit (vector, pattern, any →)
en_us.text: Writes an iota under a pattern key to an Akashic Bookshelf .

names.zh_cn: 标记描边之馏化，第二型

zh_cn.title: 施重力 (entity, vector, number →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个实体，一个代表新重力方向的轴向向量，以及相对于标准重力强度的倍数。细节见后页。
倍数可从 0 到 5 任选，包括 0 和 5。
若目标是我自己，消耗大约 1/4 个 紫水晶粉 。如果目标是其他玩家，消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶碎片 。其他情况下消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
每次施法的效果会持续大约 2.5 秒；为让这种重力长久存在，需要某种自动化 咒法学 施法方式以不断重新赋予效果。

en_us.title: Gravitate (entity, vector, number →)
en_us.text:
Takes an entity, an axial vector for new gravity, and a strength scalar relative to standard pull. Specifics are detailed on the next page.
The scalar can be any number 0 to 5 inclusive.
If the target is myself, this spell costs about one-fourth of an Amethyst Dust . If the target is another player, costs about one Amethyst Shard . Otherwises, costs about one Amethyst Dust .
Each cast of the spell only lasts for about two and a half seconds; for sustained gravitation, I will need some kind of automated Hexcasting to periodically reapply the effects.

zh_cn.title: 坠落之纯化 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回 施重力 对实体的施力方向。若实体未受 施重力 影响，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Falling Purification (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Pushes the direction that Gravitate is attempting to drag an entity, or Null if the entity is not under the effects of Gravitate .

zh_cn.title: 抓握之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回 施重力 的效果在所给实体上还会持续多少个 1/20 秒。若实体未受 施重力 影响，则返回 0。

en_us.title: Grasp Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the remaining twentieths of a second that Gravitate will affect an entity. Zero if the entity is not under the effects of Gravitate .

zh_cn.title: 冲击之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text:
返回 施重力 的效果强度相对基线的倍数。若实体未受 施重力 影响，则返回 Null 。
我发现了一些有关 重力 的理论文献。似乎每个产生 重力 的现象都有以数表示的 优先级 。 重力 对某实体的施力方向只由优先级最高的效果决定。
施重力 产生的 重力 显著较弱，其他来源的 重力 通常能盖过它。面对敌对的 咒法师 时，我可以利用这一点来锚定自身。
重力强度则更像是平等讨论决定的。 重力 的各个来源都会声明其施力倍数。对 施重力 来说，是 0 到 5 之间的数，包括 0 和 5。
产生效果时， 重力 会将所有倍数乘算，以此决定最终的施力强度。
后页会介绍用于测量“真正”的重力的若干图案。

en_us.title: Impact Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text:
Pushes the scaling factor of Gravitate 's gravity compared to baseline, or Null if the entity is not under the effects of Gravitate .
I have discovered some theorywork about Gravity . It appears every Gravity -generating phenomenon has a numerical priority . The direction Gravity pulls a given entity along is dictated by whichever force has most priority upon that entity.
The Gravity created by Gravitate is notably rather weak; other sources of Gravity often overpower it. I can use this to anchor myself against hostile Hexcasters .
Gravitational strength is settled through a much more democratic process. Each source of Gravity declares some scaling factor. For Gravitate , that is a number between and including 0 and 5.
When pulling, Gravity multiplies all the provided scaling factors together to determine the force with which to pull.
On the next few pages are some patterns used to measure true gravity.

zh_cn.title: 坠落之纯化，第二型 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回 重力 对实体的施力方向。

en_us.title: Falling Purification II (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Pushes the direction of Gravity acting on an entity.

zh_cn.title: 冲击之纯化，第二型 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text:
返回实体所受 重力 的强度相对基线的倍数。

zh_cn.title: 解码之策略
zh_cn.text: 从剪贴板读取代码，并将其解析至我手持的核心。 只能在法杖内施放。

en_us.title: Decoding Gambit
en_us.text: Reads code from my local clipboard, then parse it into the focus I'm holding. Can only be casted by staff.

zh_cn.title: 编译术 (str → list)
zh_cn.text:
将输入字符串iota编译为iota列表；若未安装 MoreIotas 则无效果。
该页面不是Minecraft的官方产品，不隶属于Mojang和Microsoft，且不代表Mojang和Microsoft的意见。
Minecraft的游戏内容和资源均为各自所有者的知识财产。
使用 hexdoc 精心制作。❤️

en_us.title: Compile (str → list)
en_us.text:
Compiles accepted string iota into an iota list; has no effect if MoreIotas not installed.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners.
Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

zh_cn.title: 换行之纯化 (num → comment)
zh_cn.text: 在栈内添加一个具有给定数目空格缩进的换行注释iota。

en_us.title: Line-Break Prfn. (num → comment)
en_us.text: Adds a line-break comment iota with space-indents of given number to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 编码之策略
zh_cn.text: 读取我手中的核心，将其内容解析为代码输出至聊天窗口。 只能在法杖内施放。

en_us.title: Encoding Gambit
en_us.text: Reads data from the focus I'm holding, and prints parsed code into chat menu. Can only be casted by staff.

zh_cn.title: 内化卓越法术 (→ list)
zh_cn.text: 从手持物品（远古卷轴、核心、制成的施法道具等）内提取卓越法术图案，返回装有解码器本次学习内容的列表。

en_us.title: Learn Great Patterns (→ list)
en_us.text: Extract great patterns from handheld items (ancient scrolls, focuses, compiled casting items, etc.), and returns a list of newly learned ones by the parser.

zh_cn.title: 压缩注释之纯化 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 清除列表内所有注释iota，返回处理后的列表。

en_us.title: No-Comment Purification (list → list)
en_us.text: Clears all comment iotas in a list, returns processed list.

zh_cn.title: 吸收之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回某人拥有的魔法保护心数。使用半颗心作为单位。

en_us.title: Absorption Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the number of magical protective hearts a person has. I can think of these in terms of half-hearts.

zh_cn.title: 执念之纯化 (entity → entity/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给实体当前正追逐的实体，需要被追逐实体在影响范围内。通常返回的是所给实体的愤恨对象。

en_us.title: Fixation Purification (entity → entity/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the entity the given entity is currently targetting if they are in ambit. This generally pushes the entity that the entity is angry at.

zh_cn.title: 愤恨之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给实体还会主动追逐另一实体多长时间。有些时候此值不会减少。

en_us.title: Grudge Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how long the given entity will stay targetting another entity. Sometimes, this number may not go down.

zh_cn.title: 养育之纯化 (biome → string/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回出生于所给生物群系的村民最可能归属的文化类别，若没有定论则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Nurture Purification (biome → string/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the villager culture most likely to be born from a given biome, or Null if no conclusion could be drawn.

zh_cn.title: 爆破兵之纯化 (block type → number)
zh_cn.text: 压入给定类型方块对爆炸的抗性。

en_us.title: Demoman's Purification (block type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how resistant blocks of this type are to explosions.

zh_cn.title: 矿工之纯化 (block type → number)
zh_cn.text: 压入挖掘给定类型方块的难易程度。

en_us.title: Miner's Purification (block type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how difficult blocks of this type are to mine.

zh_cn.title: 制图师之纯化 (block type → vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给方块在地图上的颜色。

en_us.title: Cartographer's Purif. (block type → vector)
en_us.text: Pushes the color blocks of this type appear as on a map.

zh_cn.title: 滑冰之纯化 (block type → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回方块的滑溜系数。

en_us.title: Skating Purification (block type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the slipperiness coefficient of a block.

zh_cn.title: 地质之纯化 (vec/entity/item/id → list)
zh_cn.text: 返回向量处方块、掉落的方块、代表掉落方块的物品 iota，或方块类型所归属所有标签的列表。

en_us.title: Geology Purification (vec/entity/item/id → list)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of all tags the block at the vector, dropped block, item iota encoding a dropped block, or block type belong to.

zh_cn.title: 农夫之纯化 (vector → number/null)
zh_cn.text:
压入一个 0 到 1 的数，对应农作物的生长进度，对 蜂巢 、 堆肥桶 、 炼药锅 同样有效。奇怪的是，对 蛋糕 也有效。
部分方块拥有一种或多种方块状态属性——具有简单名称的特征，可据此从同类方块中区分出特定方块。虽然这些属性无法告诉我两个 熔炉 是否在烧炼同种物品，但可以告诉我它们的朝向、它们是否在燃烧状态，或是告诉我农作物的成熟度，抑或是 栅栏门 是否被打开。
有两个图案可用于读取和分析方块属性。

en_us.title: Farmer's Purification (vector → number/null)
en_us.text:
Pushes a number 0 to 1 corresponding to the growth progress of that block. Works for crops, Beehives , Composters , Cauldrons , and strangely Cakes too.
Certain blocks have one or more blockstate properties: simple named aspects that can primitively distinguish them from other blocks of the same type. While it won't tell me whether two Furnaces are smelting the same items, it can tell me their orientation, if they are lit, how grown a crop is, and whether a Fence Gate is open.
There are two patterns for reading and analyzing the properties of blocks.

zh_cn.title: 方向之纯化 (vector → vector/null)
zh_cn.text: 压入方块的朝向向量。若该类方块不区分朝向，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Orientation Purification (vector → vector/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the vector of the block's facing direction, or Null if blocks of its type do not have an orientation.

zh_cn.title: 转肩之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体躯干的相对实体头部的旋转角度。

en_us.title: Shoulder Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the angle that an entity's body is rotated in which may be separate from its head.

zh_cn.title: 书目之纯化 (item → text, number)
zh_cn.text: 返回书的作者及书的复制代数。

en_us.title: Bibliography Purification (item → text, number)
en_us.text: Pushes the author of a book and its generation number.

zh_cn.title: 繁衍之纯化 (entity → boolean/null)
zh_cn.text: 检验动物是否处于热恋状态，准备繁衍生息；若该生物无法进行此类繁殖行为，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Reproduction Purif. (entity → boolean/null)
en_us.text: Pushes whether an animal creature is in love and ready to mate, or Null if that creature is not capable of that type of reproduction.

zh_cn.title: 炼狱之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体身上的火焰距自然熄灭剩余多少秒，实体未在燃烧则返回 -1。

en_us.title: Inferno Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the number of seconds the burning entity will continue burning if not put out. -1 if the entity is not burning currently.

zh_cn.title: 猫咪之纯化 (entity → string)
zh_cn.text: 返回 猫 的品种。

en_us.title: Feline Purification (entity → string)
en_us.text: Pushes the variant of the Cat .

zh_cn.title: 样式之馏化 (display, display → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验两 文形 的样式是否相同。

en_us.title: Stylistic Distillation (display, display → boolean)
en_us.text: Returns whether the two display iotas have the same style.

zh_cn.title: 库房之纯化 (item coerceable → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，返回其中最多可堆叠多少物品。

en_us.title: Warehouse Purification (item coerceable → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes how many items that can stack in it at most.

zh_cn.title: 仓储之纯化 (item → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品，返回其中物品数量。

en_us.title: Storage Purification (item → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item and pushes how many items are in it.

zh_cn.title: 阅读之纯化 (any → display)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 iota，返回代表它的 文形 。

en_us.title: Reading Purification (any → display)
en_us.text: Takes an iota and returns a display iota representing it.

zh_cn.title: 献物之馏化 (item coerceable, number → item)
zh_cn.text: 由物品类型和组内物品数制造物品。

en_us.title: Offer Distillation (item coerceable, number → item)
en_us.text: Creates an item iota from an item type and the number of items in the stack.

zh_cn.title: 怒气之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回 苦力怕 爆炸的进度。

en_us.title: Anger Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the progress of a Creeper to explosion.

zh_cn.title: 脆弱性之纯化 (item coerceable → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，返回物品的耐久度上限。

en_us.title: Fragility Purification (item coerceable → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes how much durability the item can have at its peak.

zh_cn.title: 损耗之纯化 (item coerceable → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品，返回物品所受的损坏值。

en_us.title: Deterioration Purif. (item coerceable → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item and pushes how much damage the item has sustained.

zh_cn.title: 文形流之纯化 (display → list of displays)
zh_cn.text:
将 文形 转换成一长串单个带样式字符组成的流。子文形也会经历此变换。
和 文形 交互的图案有着奇异的多面性。它们看上去像是馏化，但实际上是 策略 。
传入对应的参数后，这些图案会对其根 文形 做出对应的改动（各页有附例）。
如果栈顶就只是一个 文形 ，那么这些图案会返回对应样式当前的值。

en_us.title: Streaming Purification (display → list of displays)
en_us.text:
Transforms a display iota into a long stream of styled single characters, including its children.
The patterns that interact with display iotas are strangely multifaceted. While resembling distillations, they are actually gambits .
If their described arguments are passed in, they modify the display iota 's root according to their speciality (example of modification included).
If the top of the stack is just a display iota however, they push the current value of the setting that they target.

zh_cn.title: 哥特式之策略 (display, boolean → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取或设定文形为 粗体 与否，格式为一个布尔值。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。

en_us.title: Gothic Gambit (display, boolean → display)
en_us.text: Gets or sets a boolean, corresponding to whether it is bold . Pass in Null to defer to parent.

zh_cn.title: 递归之策略 (display → list of displays)
zh_cn.text: 获取 文形 的子 文形 列表，或将列表中的文形设为其子文形。

en_us.title: Recursive Gambit (display → list of displays)
en_us.text: Gets or sets a list of display iotas corresponding to children of the display iota .

zh_cn.title: 卢米埃尔之策略 (display, vector → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取或设定文本颜色，格式为各分量在 0 到 1 之间的向量。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。

en_us.title: Lumière Gambit (display, vector → display)
en_us.text: Gets or sets the text color encoded as a vector whose components range from 0 to 1. Pass in Null to defer to parent.

zh_cn.title: 书法师之策略 (display, number → display)
zh_cn.text:
获取或设定文形的字体，格式为一个数。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。
我目前所知的字体分别对应 0、1、2。0 为标准字体，1 是能在 附魔台 周围看见的符文，2 对应传闻中古代村民所用的奇怪符文。

en_us.title: Calligrapher's Gambit (display, number → display)
en_us.text:
Gets or sets a number, corresponding to the font a text is drawn in. Pass in Null to defer to parent.
0, 1, and 2 are the current fonts that I know of, corresponding to standard appearance, the runes I see surrounding an Enchanting Table , and a strange variant of it that is allegedly used by ancient villagers.

zh_cn.title: 马努提乌斯之策略 (display, boolean → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取或设定文形为 斜体 与否，格式为一个布尔值。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。

en_us.title: Manutius' Gambit (display, boolean → display)
en_us.text: Gets or sets a boolean, corresponding to whether it is in italics . Pass in Null to defer to parent.

zh_cn.title: 审查员之策略 (display, boolean → display)
zh_cn.text:
获取或设定文形为随机 文本 与否，格式为一个布尔值。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。
能以魔法影响到世界的图案和操作。

en_us.title: Censor's Gambit (display, boolean → display)
en_us.text:
Gets or sets a boolean, corresponding to whether it is obfusca ted . Pass in Null to defer to parent.
Patterns and actions that perform a magical effect on the world.

zh_cn.title: 编辑员之策略 (display, boolean → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取或设定文形有无 删除线 ，格式为一个布尔值。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。

en_us.title: Editor's Gambit (display, boolean → display)
en_us.text: Gets or sets a boolean, corresponding to whether it has been struck through . Pass in Null to defer to parent.

zh_cn.title: 记录员之策略 (display, boolean → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取或设定文形有无 下划线 ，格式为一个布尔值。传入 Null 可令其继承父文形。

en_us.title: Notetaker's Gambit (display, boolean → display)
en_us.text: Gets or sets a boolean, corresponding to whether it is underlined . Pass in Null to defer to parent.

zh_cn.title: 可食性之纯化 (item coerceable → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，检验它是否可被我食用。

en_us.title: Edibility Purification (item coerceable → boolean)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes whether I can eat it.

zh_cn.title: 成咒之馏化 (item/enchantment, enchantment → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验物品及其当前魔咒是否支持所给魔咒类型，或两个魔咒是否相互兼容。

en_us.title: Conjuring Distillation (item/enchantment, enchantment → boolean)
en_us.text: Returns whether the item and its current enchantments can support the given enchantment type, or if two enchantments can support each other.

zh_cn.title: 咒峰之纯化 (enchantment type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取魔咒类别可自然达到的最大等级。

en_us.title: Peak Purification (enchantment type → number)
en_us.text: Gets the maximum level the enchantment type can naturally achieve.

zh_cn.title: 咒谷之纯化 (enchantment type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取魔咒类别可自然达到的最小等级。

en_us.title: Valley Purification (enchantment type → number)
en_us.text: Gets the minimum level the enchantment type can naturally achieve.

zh_cn.title: 成咒之纯化 (enchantment type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取发现此魔咒的相对难易程度。例如，有某个常见的魔咒返回 10，又有某个极其稀有的魔咒返回 1，那么前者的出现概率即是后者的 10 倍。

en_us.title: Conjuring Purification (enchantment type → number)
en_us.text: Gets the relative ease of finding this enchantment. For example, common enchantments return 10 and are thus ten times more likely than very rare enchantments that return 1.

zh_cn.title: 名称之纯化 (entity → display)
zh_cn.text: 以 文形 形式返回所给实体的名称，带格式。

en_us.title: Name Purification (entity → display)
en_us.text: Pushes a display iota with the formatted name of the entity.

zh_cn.title: 骑士之纯化 (entity → list of entities)
zh_cn.text: 返回骑乘所给实体的实体列表。

en_us.title: Jockey Purification (entity → list of entities)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of entities that are riding the given entity.

zh_cn.title: 种属之纯化 (entity/entity type → list)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体或实体类型所归属所有标签的列表。

en_us.title: Genus Purification (entity/entity type → list)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of all tags the entity or entity type belongs to.

zh_cn.title: 载具之纯化 (entity → entity/null)
zh_cn.text: 检验所给实体是否处于骑乘状态，若未在骑乘或未乘坐载具，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Vehicle Purification (entity → entity/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the entity the given entity is riding or Null if it is not riding in or on anything.

zh_cn.title: 卡尺之纯化 (entity/entity type → number)
zh_cn.text: 类似 测高仪之纯化 ，但返回的不是实体的高度，而是实体的宽度。

en_us.title: Caliper's Purification (entity/entity type → number)
en_us.text: Similar to Stadiometer's Purification but pushes the width of an entity rather than its height.

zh_cn.title: 影响范围之纯化 (entity/vector → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验所给位置或实体是否处于影响范围中。

en_us.title: Ambit Purification (entity/vector → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether a location or entity is in ambit.

zh_cn.title: 建构之精思 (→ boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验该图案是否由某种 卓伟之作 施放。

en_us.title: Constructed Reflection (→ boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether some form of grand work is being used to cast this pattern.

zh_cn.title: 媒质之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 返回当前施放可用的 媒质 的量。

en_us.title: Media Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes the media available to the current cast.

zh_cn.title: 敏捷之精思 (→ boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验该图案是否由施法者的主手施放。在没有手的施法者身上可能会产生奇怪的效果。

en_us.title: Dexterity Reflection (→ boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the dominant hand of the caster is being used to cast this pattern. May return strange results for casters without hands.

zh_cn.title: 设备之精思 (→ boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验该图案是否由任意 施法物品 施放。

en_us.title: Device Reflection (→ boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether any form of casting device is being used to cast this pattern.

zh_cn.title: 法杖之精思 (→ boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验该图案是否由 法杖 施放。

en_us.title: Staff Reflection (→ boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether a Staff is being used to cast this pattern.

zh_cn.title: 窒息之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 压入实体距离窒息剩余多少秒。对脱水的海洋生物和溺水的陆地生物均有效。

en_us.title: Suffocation Purif. (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the number of seconds before an entity will start to suffocate. This applies to marine creatures out of water as well as land creatures in water.

zh_cn.title: 埃癸斯之纯化 (entity → list of items)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体穿着的全部物品组成的列表，顺序自下向上。

en_us.title: Aegis Purification (entity → list of items)
en_us.text: Returns a list of all items the entity is wearing, from feet up.

zh_cn.title: 地理之纯化 (vector → identifier)
zh_cn.text: 返回给定位置向量处的生物群系类别。

en_us.title: Geographical Purif. (vector → identifier)
en_us.text: Pushes the type of biome the vector is within.

zh_cn.title: 箱子之纯化 (vector → list of items | null)
zh_cn.text: 返回容器装有的全部物品组成的列表；若方块无法容纳物品，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Chest Purification (vector → list of items | null)
en_us.text: Returns a list of all items in the container, or Null if the block can not contain items.

zh_cn.title: 侧征之纯化 (vector → list of strings)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给方块的方块状态属性列表。

en_us.title: Facet Purification (vector → list of strings)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of all blockstate property of the given block.

zh_cn.title: 现实之纯化 (vector → number)
zh_cn.text:
返回给定区块受物体恒存性影响的程度。
我离某区域越远，那里的现实就越稀薄，最稀薄时那些地方便不再存在。此图案会返回给定位置现实的浓度。
-1：尚未存在。0：由于距离过远而不再存在。这些地方的实体会变为 Null 。1：此处的实体和方块存在，且可获取其引用，但该处的时间不流动。2：方块正常运作，实体的时间凝固。3：完全正常的现实。

en_us.title: Reality Purification (vector → number)
en_us.text:
Pushes the degree to which a given chunk is experiencing object permanence.
The further I travel from a place, the less reality seems to exist there until it just ceases to be at all. This pattern returns the degree of existence a given location is experiencing.
-1: it has not yet existed. 0: it does not exist due to lack of presence. Entities here become Null . 1: entities and blocks exist here and can be queried, but no time flows. 2: blocks function but entities are frozen in time. 3: full and regular operation of reality.

zh_cn.title: 外设之纯化 (vector → number/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回 比较器 对准给定位置时会输出的红石信号强度。

en_us.title: Peripheral Purification (vector → number/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the power level a Comparator would output if pressed against a position.

zh_cn.title: 昼夜之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 返回世界自创建至今的天数。小数部分为一天的进程。

en_us.title: Circadian Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes the number of days since the creation of the world. Includes decimal for progress of current day.

zh_cn.title: 位面之精思 (→ dimension)
zh_cn.text: 压入 咒术 施放时所处的维度。

en_us.title: Plane Reflection (→ dimension)
en_us.text: Pushes the dimension the Hex is being cast in.

zh_cn.title: 浓度之馏化 (entity, status effect type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取实体身上某效果的强度，无给定效果则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Concentration Dstl. (entity, status effect type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how potent the effect type is acting on the entity or Null if the entity doesn't have it.

zh_cn.title: 药性之纯化 (status effect type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取某效果对承受者造成的效应是“良性”与否。-1 为负面，0 为中性，1 为正面。

en_us.title: Condition Purification (status effect type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the general goodness of the effect towards the afflicted. -1 for harmful, 0 for neutral, and 1 for beneficial.

zh_cn.title: 效除之馏化 (entity, status effect type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取效果的持续时间，以 1/20 秒计，无给定效果则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Clearance Distillation (entity, status effect type → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how long the effect type will affect the entity in twentieths of a second or Null if the entity doesn't have it.

zh_cn.title: 诊断之纯化 (entity → list of status effect types)
zh_cn.text: 获取实体当前状态效果组成的列表。

en_us.title: Diagnosis Purification (entity → list of status effect types)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of status effects the entity is afflicted with.

zh_cn.title: 处方之纯化 (item → list of status effect types)
zh_cn.text: 获取食物或药水提供的状态效果列表。

en_us.title: Prescription Purif. (item → list of status effect types)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of status effects the food or potion will bestow.

zh_cn.title: 扭曲之精思 (→ boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验 指南针 和 钟 可否在 咒术 施放时所处的维度中运作。

en_us.title: Distortion Reflection (→ boolean)
en_us.text:
Pushes whether Compasses and Clocks will work in the dimension the Hex is being cast in.

zh_cn.title: 咒能之馏化 (item, enchantment type → number)
zh_cn.text: 获取物品中给定魔咒的强度。

en_us.title: Charm Distillation (item, enchantment type → number)
en_us.text: Gets the strength of the specific enchantment on the item.

zh_cn.title: 奇术师之纯化 (item → list of enchantment types)
zh_cn.text: 获取物品上魔咒组成的列表。

en_us.title: Thaumaturgist's Purif. (item → list of enchantment types)
en_us.text: Gets a list of enchantments the item has.

zh_cn.title: 口袋之精思 (→ list of items)
zh_cn.text: 返回我末影箱中全部物品组成的列表。

en_us.title: Pocket Reflection (→ list of items)
en_us.text: Returns a list of all items in my ender chest.

zh_cn.title: 生命力之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 压入实体距离死亡还有多远。使用半颗心作为单位。

en_us.title: Vitality Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how close an entity is to death. I can think of these in terms of half-hearts.

zh_cn.title: 卡路里之纯化 (item coerceable → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，返回它为我带来的饱腹感的量。

en_us.title: Calorie Purification (item coerceable → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes the amount it will fill me.

zh_cn.title: 矿车之纯化 (entity → list of items | null)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体装有的全部物品组成的列表；若实体无法容纳物品，则返回 Null 。试图访问其他 玩家 的物品栏会招致事故。

en_us.title: Cart Purification (entity → list of items | null)
en_us.text: Returns a list of all items the entity is carrying, or Null if the entity can not hold items. Trying to access another Player 's inventory will incur a mishap.

zh_cn.title: 展示之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回 物品展示框 的旋转方向，为 0 到 7 的整数。

en_us.title: Showcase Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the rotation of an Item Frame as an integer 0 to 7.

zh_cn.title: 光照之纯化 (vector → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回给定位置的光照等级，返回值在 0 到 15 之间。如果位置处于不透明方块内部，返回 0。

en_us.title: Luminance Purification (vector → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the light level at the position as a number 0 to 15. If inside a nontransparent block, it returns zero.

zh_cn.title: 工具之纯化 (entity → item)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体主手的物品。

en_us.title: Tool Purification (entity → item)
en_us.text: Returns the item in the entity's mainhand.

zh_cn.title: 双肺之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回给定类型实体在离开其呼吸环境后需多少秒开始窒息。

en_us.title: Lung Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the number of seconds a regular entity of that type can last outside their normal breathing environment before they start suffocating.

zh_cn.title: 健康之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 压入实体处于完全健康状态时的生命值。使用半颗心作为单位。

en_us.title: Fitness Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how much health an entity can have at its prime. I can think of these in terms of half-hearts.

zh_cn.title: 潜能之纯化 (any → number/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体、方块、物品可容纳的最大 媒质 量。若其无法存储 媒质 或没有良好定义的所谓最大值，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Potential Purification (any → number/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the maximum amount of media an entity, block, or item has or contains, or Null if the item does not have any media -holding potential or no neatly defined maximum.

zh_cn.title: 媒质之纯化 (any → number/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体、方块、物品容纳的 媒质 的量。若其无法存储 媒质 的功能，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Media Purification (any → number/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the amount of media an entity, block, or item has or contains, or Null if the item does not have any media -holding potential.

zh_cn.title: 新闻之精思 (→ display, display, number)
zh_cn.text: 以 文形 形式返回最近一次使用聊天栏的玩家，同时以 文形 形式返回该消息，以及发送时间距现在有多少个 1/20 秒。

en_us.title: News Reflection (→ display, display, number)
en_us.text: Pushes a display iota of the last person to use chat, a display iota of the message, and a number of twentieths of a second since that message sent.

zh_cn.title: 新闻之拆解 (num → display, display, num)
zh_cn.text: 与 新闻之精思 类似，但会作用于 n 次前发送的消息，最多可回溯 64 条消息。

en_us.title: News Disintegration (num → display, display, num)
en_us.text: Acts similarly to News Reflection but acts on the message sent n messages ago, up to sixty four messages ago.

zh_cn.title: 月相之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 返回当前的月相，返回值为可见的 月亮 照亮区域的占比。

en_us.title: Lunar Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes the current phase of the Moon as a fraction of its size.

zh_cn.title: 配件之纯化 (entity → item)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体副手的物品。

en_us.title: Accessory Purification (entity → item)
en_us.text: Returns the item in the entity's offhand.

zh_cn.title: 饥饿之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回 玩家 的饥饿值。使用半个火腿作为单位。

en_us.title: Hunger Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how full a Player is. I can think of this in terms of half-hunches.

zh_cn.title: 耐力之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回 玩家 的饱和度。这一数据大致与饱腹感的持续时间对应。

en_us.title: Stamina Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes a Player 's saturation, which roughly correlates to how long the Player will remain full.

zh_cn.title: 电池之纯化 (vector → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回给定位置的红石信号强度。

en_us.title: Battery Purification (vector → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the Redstone power that a position receives.

zh_cn.title: 饱和之纯化 (item coerceable → number)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，返回其饱和度。这一数据大致与饱腹感的持续时间对应。

en_us.title: Satiation Purification (item coerceable → number)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes the saturation value, which roughly affects how long it will fill me.

zh_cn.title: 驱魔师之纯化 (vector → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验 史莱姆 有无概率生成于所给位置，是否位于沼泽对结果无影响。

en_us.title: Exorcist's Purification (vector → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether Slimes are likely to spawn in this location, even if it is not a swamp.

zh_cn.title: 物品之纯化 (entity → item)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给 物品 实体对应的物品。

en_us.title: Item Purification (entity → item)
en_us.text: Pushes the item that an Item in the world is.

zh_cn.title: 时间之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 压入世界经过的时间，主要用来计时，不受睡觉等事件的影响。以 1/20 秒计。

en_us.title: Temporal Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes the twentieths of a second since the creation of the world, unaffected by events such as sleeping.

zh_cn.title: 天气学家之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个代表天气的数。0 为晴天，1 为降雨，2 为雷暴。

en_us.title: Meterologist's Refl. (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes a number corresponding to the weather. 0 for clear, 1 for rain, and 2 for thundering.

zh_cn.title: 青春之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验活体是否处于幼年状态。奇怪的是对 盔甲架 也有效。

en_us.title: Youth Purification (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether a living creature is a baby. Also works on Armor Stands oddly.

zh_cn.title: 虚空之纯化 (vector → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验方块是否是某种空气。

en_us.title: Void Purification (vector → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the block is a form of air.

zh_cn.title: 覆写之纯化 (vector → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验方块是否足够脆弱以至于可替换，就和 矮草丛 和空气一样。

en_us.title: Overwriting Purification (vector → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the block is typically weak enough to be overwritten, such as Grass and the air.

zh_cn.title: 感知之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验实体是否“被魔法手段去除了意识”。我总觉得它和 剥离意识 之间有种紧密的联系……

en_us.title: Sentience Purification (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether an entity has been magically relieved of its mind . I feel this is strongly related to Flay Mind somehow...

zh_cn.title: 诅咒之纯化 (enchantment type → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验魔咒是否是诅咒，从而无法通过 砂轮 移除。

en_us.title: Curse Purification (enchantment type → boolean)
en_us.text: Returns whether the enchantment is considered a curse and is not removable via Grindstone .

zh_cn.title: 寓言之纯化 (enchantment type → boolean)
zh_cn.text:
检验魔咒是否是宝藏魔咒，也即它是否无法通过 附魔台 发现。
该页面不是Minecraft的官方产品，不隶属于Mojang和Microsoft，且不代表Mojang和Microsoft的意见。
Minecraft的游戏内容和资源均为各自所有者的知识财产。
使用 hexdoc 精心制作。❤️

en_us.title: Fable Purification (enchantment type → boolean)
en_us.text: Returns whether the enchantment is a treasure, meaning it can not be found via Enchanting Table .

zh_cn.title: 显圣之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验所给玩家是否和我一样经过 启迪 。

en_us.title: Epiphany Purification (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the given player has achieved Enlightenment .

zh_cn.title: 肉类之纯化 (item coerceable → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，检验它是否是肉类，也即 狼 能否食用。

en_us.title: Flesh Purification (item coerceable → boolean)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes whether it's considered a meat. Wolves can eat meats.

zh_cn.title: 恶意之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验所给实体是否天性邪恶，也即雪傀儡会不会一看见它就发起攻击。铁傀儡也会在看见此类实体时发起攻击（苦力怕除外）。

en_us.title: Malevolence Purif. (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the given entity is considered inherently evil, i.e. a Snow Golem will attack it on sight. Iron Golems will also attack these creatures on sight, with the exception of Creepers.

zh_cn.title: 树懒之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验 玩家 、 猫 、 狐狸 、以及其他实体是否处于睡眠状态。

en_us.title: Sloth's Purification (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the Player , Cat , Fox , or other entity is sleeping.

zh_cn.title: 甜点之纯化 (item coerceable → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 弹出一个物品类型，检验它是否算作小食。

en_us.title: Dessert Purification (item coerceable → boolean)
en_us.text: Pops an item type and pushes whether it's a snack.

zh_cn.title: 赛车手之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验 玩家 、 猫 、 狐狸 、以及其他实体是否在疾跑。速泳和疾跑后离地均算作疾跑。

en_us.title: Racer's Purification (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the Player , Cat , Fox , or other entity is sprinting. Swimming and leaving the ground after starting to sprint are still included.

zh_cn.title: 末影人之纯化 (entity → boolean)
zh_cn.text: 检验实体是否身处雨中、水中、或气泡柱中。

en_us.title: Enderman's Purif. (entity → boolean)
en_us.text: Pushes whether the entity is touching rain, water, or in a bubble column.

zh_cn.title: 传承之纯化 (item → list of displays)
zh_cn.text: 获取物品的说明。

en_us.title: Legacy Purification (item → list of displays)
en_us.text: Gets the lore written into this item.

zh_cn.title: 称谓之纯化 (item → display)
zh_cn.text: 获取物品的名称。

en_us.title: Appellation Purification (item → display)
en_us.text: Gets the name given to this item.

zh_cn.title: 收藏家之纯化 (item → number)
zh_cn.text: 测量物品的稀有度，返回为数，值越大越稀有。魔咒等特殊性质可能会提升物品的稀有度。

en_us.title: Collector Purification (item → number)
en_us.text: Gauges the rarity of an item as a number, with greater values corresponding to a rarer item. Certain aspects such as enchantments can also elevate an item's rarity.

zh_cn.title: 饰品之纯化 (entity/item/item type → list)
zh_cn.text: 返回掉落的物品、物品 iota，或物品类型所归属所有标签的列表。

en_us.title: Bauble Purification (entity/item/item type → list)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of all the tags the dropped item, item iota, or item type belong to.

zh_cn.title: 魅力之纯化 (item → number)
zh_cn.text: 如果物品会受到 施法者之魅力 的影响，则返回其当前外形对应的索引；否则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Glamour Purification (item → number)
en_us.text: If this item is subceptible to Caster's Glamour , pushes the index of the current form it's taking on. Otherwise pushes Null .

zh_cn.title: 魅力之纯化，第二型 (item → number)
zh_cn.text: 如果物品会受到 施法者之魅力 的影响，则返回其可变化的外形总数；否则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Glamour Purification II (item → number)
en_us.text: If this item is subceptible to Caster's Glamour , pushes the number of forms it's capable of. Otherwise pushes Null .

zh_cn.title: 疮疤之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给实体从上一次被攻击到现在经过了多少个 1/20 秒。

en_us.title: Scar Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how long ago in twentieths of a second the given entity was last attacked.

zh_cn.title: 受害者之纯化 (entity → entity/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回上一个攻击了所给实体的实体，需攻击者在影响范围内。

en_us.title: Victim Purification (entity → entity/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the last entity that attacked the given one, if they are within ambit.

zh_cn.title: 艺术之纯化 (entity → string)
zh_cn.text: 返回 画 的类型。

en_us.title: Artistic Purification (entity → string)
en_us.text: Pushes the variant of the Painting .

zh_cn.title: 转记器之纯化 (display/string → string/display)
zh_cn.text: 使用字符串创建无格式的文形，或是将文形的文本内容转换成字符串。

en_us.title: Transcriber Purification (display/string → string/display)
en_us.text: Creates a bland display from a string, or creates a string that captures an unstyled version of the display.

zh_cn.title: 挚宠之纯化 (entity → entity/null)
zh_cn.text: 检验玩家是否驯服了所给动物，若未驯服或玩家在影响范围之外，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Adoration Purification (entity → entity/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the player that has tamed this animal, or Null if it is untamed or the player is out of ambit.

zh_cn.title: 时限之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回实体的存在时间，以 1/20 秒计，但会在大约 10 秒后停止记录。大概，适合用来选择刚发射的弹射物？

en_us.title: Age Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes the age of an entity in twentieths of a second although loses track after about ten seconds. Useful for selecting only newly fired projectiles perhaps?

zh_cn.title: 侧征之馏化 (vector, string → any)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个方块和一个方块状态属性，若可行则返回该属性的值。
若方块没有给定属性，则返回 Null 。大多数情况下，返回的结果很好理解：布尔值、方向向量、字符串、整数，总之是最合乎属性数据的 iota。
如果属性太过生僻，则会返回无意义的 iota。

en_us.title: Facet Distillation (vector, string → any)
en_us.text:
Takes a block and a blockstate property and pushes that property's value if possible.
If the block does not have the property, the pattern pushes Null . For the most part, it is quite intuitive: the pattern produces booleans, directional vectors, strings, and integers, whichever best represents the property's data.
If a property is too alien, a senseless iota is produced.

zh_cn.title: 文学之纯化 (item → list of text)
zh_cn.text: 将书中文本组为 文形 列表返回；如所给参数不是书，则返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Literature Purification (item → list of text)
en_us.text: Pushes a list of display iotas contained inside a book or Null if it isn't a book.

zh_cn.title: 展示之策略 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text: 设置 物品展示框 的旋转方向，需用 0 到 7 的整数。

en_us.title: Showcase Gambit (entity, number →)
en_us.text: Sets the rotation of an Item Frame to a given integer 0 to 7.

zh_cn.title: 描述物品 (entity, list of display/null →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个物品和一个文形列表，将文形列表加至物品作为描述。传入 Null 时清除描述。无需消耗 媒质 。
我偶然间触及了一条完全将 媒质 用于获取和处理世界信息的学术分支。
虽然这些操作在大多数 咒术 中没什么大用处，但有它们在也不错，我将来也许会用到。

en_us.title: Describe Item (entity, list of display/null →)
en_us.text:
Takes an item and a list of display iotas to append as a description. Clears if given Null . Free.
I have stumbled upon a branch of manipulating media entirely focused around information about the world.
While likely not useful for the majority of Hexes , these will be convenient to have, should I ever need them.

zh_cn.title: 命名物品 (entity, display/null →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个物品，将其重命名为给定文形。传入 Null 时重置名称。无需消耗 媒质 。

en_us.title: Name Item (entity, display/null →)
en_us.text: Takes an item and renames it to the display iota given. Resets name if given Null . Free.

zh_cn.title: 射手之纯化 (entity → entity/null)
zh_cn.text: 返回所给弹射物实体的发射者，若无发射者或不是弹射物，则返回 Null 。如果发射者在我影响范围之外，也会返回 Null 。

en_us.title: Shooter Purification (entity → entity/null)
en_us.text: Pushes the shooter of the given projectile entity or Null if it has no shooter or isn't a projectile. It also pushes Null if the shooter is outside my ambit.

zh_cn.title: 经纬仪之纯化 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 类似 照准仪之纯化 ，但返回向量并不指向实体的视线，而是自其头部指向上方。

en_us.title: Theodolite Purif. (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Similar to Alidade's Purification but pushes the vector that points upwards from their head rather than the entity's facing vector.

zh_cn.title: 职级之纯化 (entity → number)
zh_cn.text: 返回代表村民技艺功底和精通程度的数。

en_us.title: Tier Purification (entity → number)
en_us.text: Pushes how advanced a villager is as a number, encoding mastery of their craft.

zh_cn.title: 职业之纯化 (entity → string)
zh_cn.text: 将村民的职业返回为字符串。

en_us.title: Professional Purif. (entity → string)
en_us.text: Pushes the villager's profession as a string.

zh_cn.title: 文化之纯化 (entity → biome)
zh_cn.text: 返回村民所归属的大致文化类别。通常来说比生物群系范围要广，如所有沙漠归在同一类，所有丛林归在同一类等。

en_us.title: Culture Purification (entity → biome)
en_us.text: Pushes the general culture that a villager was born into. These are generally more broad than specific biomes, like deserts as a whole or jungles as a whole.

zh_cn.title: 源质分析 (entity → recipe)
zh_cn.text:
移除一个物品实体，返回该物品的组成配方 iota。 分析成功后物品会崩解。
目标没有有效组成配方时会招致事故。 消耗 5 个 充能紫水晶 。
该页面不是Minecraft的官方产品，不隶属于Mojang和Microsoft，且不代表Mojang和Microsoft的意见。
Minecraft的游戏内容和资源均为各自所有者的知识财产。
使用 hexdoc 精心制作。❤️

en_us.title: Analysis (entity → recipe)
en_us.text:
Remove an item entity, then add an iota representing the combination recipe for that item to the stack. Successful analyses tear the item apart.
Mishaps if target does not have a valid combination recipe. Costs 5 Charged Amethyst.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners.
Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

zh_cn.title: 源质组合 ([vec], recipe, vec →)
zh_cn.text: 移除一个向量列表、一个 配方 iota 、一个向量，再从列表内各位置的源质罐中提取源质，并根据给定配方加以混合，而后在给定位置召唤产物。

en_us.title: Combination ([vec], recipe, vec →)
en_us.text: Remove a list of vectors, a recipe iota , and a vector from the stack, then take essences from the jars at the given locations, mix them according to the given recipe, and summon the resulting item at the given location.

zh_cn.title: 配方拆解 (recipe → [[itemtype, num]])
zh_cn.text:
将 配方 iota 拆解为由列表组成的列表，内层各列表均由物品类型和数量组成。 此 iota 记录了配方所需源质的种类与数量。
这类法术据信极难施放，但也极为强力。记载它们的文献极为 少见 （据称理由充分）。这也许只是某些消亡的老古董口中的胡言乱语，不过——它们只是简单的图案罢了。
试试看又能出什么错呢？

en_us.title: Decay (recipe → [[itemtype, num]])
en_us.text:
Decays a Recipe iota into a list of lists where the inner lists each contain an item type and a count. This list of lists represents which essences the recipe needs, and how much of each.
The spells catalogued here are purported to be of legendary difficulty and power. They seem to have been recorded only sparsely (for good reason, the texts claim). It's probably just the ramblings of extinct traditionalists, though -- a pattern's a pattern.
What could possibly go wrong?

zh_cn.title: 源质提取 (entity →)
zh_cn.text: 提取掉落物品的源质。消耗随目标物品而变。

en_us.title: Extraction (entity →)
en_us.text: Extracts the essence from a dropped item. Cost varies depending on target item.

names.zh_cn: 留项之策略：至大第二型
留项之策略：至小第二型

zh_cn.title: 速记员之馏化 (entity | vec, num → any)
zh_cn.text:
从实体或方块中读出一个列表 iota，并将其中给定下标处的 iota 压入栈中。
这个图案和后页的图案似乎很适合处理大批量的数据，而且不会因此招致 Iota 过多 事故。

en_us.title: Tachygrapher's Dstl. (entity | vec, num → any)
en_us.text:
Read a list iota out of an entity or block, then push the iota at the specified index to the stack.
It seems this and the next pattern may be useful for handling large amounts of data without causing a Too Many Iotas mishap.

zh_cn.title: 速记员之策略 (entity | vec, num, any →)
zh_cn.text: 从实体或方块中读出一个列表 iota，并将该列表中给定下标处的元素修改为所给 iota，最后把修改后的列表写入原实体或方块。

en_us.title: Tachygrapher's Gambit (entity | vec, num, any →)
en_us.text: Read a list iota out of an entity or block, then set the element at the specified index of that list to the given iota, then write the resulting list back to the entity or block.

zh_cn.title: 赫尔墨斯之勇气 (list of pattern →)
zh_cn.text: 像赫尔墨斯之策略那样执行图案列表，但是不会规定“卡戎之策略”的退出位置

zh_cn.title: 赫菲斯托斯之策略 (list of patterns → many|mishap)
zh_cn.text: 移除并执行栈顶的一个可执行iota，如果中途抛出事故，立刻跳出这个执行并把那个事故Iota压入栈顶

en_us.title: Hephaestus's Gambit (list of patterns → many|mishap)
en_us.text: Removes the topmost evaluatable iota from the stack. If a mishap is thrown during its execution, the pattern immediately breaks out of that evaluation and pushes the resulting Mishap Iota onto the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 抽出之提整 (list,num,num → list)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个列表和两个数字。返回从索引第一个数字开始、长度为第二个数字的子列表。

en_us.title: Extraction Strategy (list,num,num → list)
en_us.text: Accepts a list and two numbers. Returns the sublist starting at the first number with length equal to the second number, and the remaining elements.

zh_cn.title: 插入之提整 (list,list,num → list)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个列表，一个列表和一个数字。将后一个列表中的元素插入到前一个列表中给定数为索引之后的元素之后。

en_us.title: Insertion Refinement (list,list,num → list)
en_us.text: Accepts a list at position 0, a list at position 1, and a number at position 2. Inserts elements from the list at position 1 after the element at the given index in the list at position 0.

zh_cn.title: 附魔师之策略 (entity，enchant →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个附魔iota和一个物品实体，附魔那个物品，消耗魔咒等级的立方数值的紫水晶粉的媒质

en_us.title: Enchanter Strategy (entity，enchant →)
en_us.text: Accepts an enchantment iota and an item entity, enchants that item, consuming media of amethyst dust with the cube of the enchantment level plus one amethyst shard

zh_cn.title: 铁砧之馏化 (enchant,enchant → enchant)
zh_cn.text: 接受两个同种魔咒的附魔iota，将它们的等级相加，返回新的高等级魔咒

en_us.title: Enchant Add (enchant,enchant → enchant)
en_us.text: Accepts two enchantment iotas of the same type, adds their levels together, and returns a new high-level enchantment

zh_cn.title: 达尔文之策略 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 对所给列表中的每一个元素执行所给列表中的操作，将结果依次置入一个新列表中，返回那个列表。

zh_cn.title: 附魔师之纯化 (entity → list of enchant)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个附魔物品实体，返回由其上所有附魔对应的iota组成的列表，可能是由于密封较好，不能读取附魔书上的附魔

en_us.title: Enchanter Purification (entity → list of enchant)
en_us.text: Accepts an item entity and returns a list of iotas corresponding to all enchantments on it

zh_cn.title: 苏格拉底之馏化 (entity, idea → idea)
zh_cn.text: 消耗少量媒质。将目标实体的基础属性（最大生命值、速度、攻击、护甲）提取到空理型中。

en_us.title: Socrates Distillation (entity, idea → idea)
en_us.text: Consumes a small amount of media. Extracts base attributes (max health, speed, attack, armor) from the target entity into an empty idea.

zh_cn.title: 亚里士多德之提整 (idea, num, num → idea)
zh_cn.text:
消耗少量媒质。修改理型的一个属性。索引1~4对应：最大生命值、速度、攻击、护甲。

Minecraft的游戏内容和资源均为各自所有者的知识财产。
使用 hexdoc 精心制作。❤️

en_us.title: Aristotle Refinement (idea, num, num → idea)
en_us.text:
Consumes a small amount of media. Modifies one attribute of an idea. Indices 1~4 correspond to: max health, speed, attack, armor.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners.
Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

zh_cn.title: 析理之纯化 (mishap → many)
zh_cn.text:
抽取出事故 iota 中的关键参数：无效的参数、需要的参数数量、出错的实体或位置等。若事故类型不被支持，则返回 Null。
能以魔法影响到世界的图案和操作。

en_us.title: Rational Distillation (mishap → many)
en_us.text:
Extracts key parameters from a Mishap Iota: the invalid perpetrator, the number of missing arguments, the offending entity or location, etc. Returns Null if the mishap type is not supported.
Patterns and actions that perform a magical effect on the world.

zh_cn.title: 剖因之纯化 (mishap → type)
zh_cn.text: 揭示事故 iota 内部的事故类型，以 TypeIota 的形式返回。若事故已衰变，会指出它是“损坏的事故”。

en_us.title: Causal Purification (mishap → type)
en_us.text: Reveals the mishap type stored inside a Mishap Iota, also as a TypeIota. If the mishap has decayed, it will indicate a Broken Mishap .

zh_cn.title: 柏拉图之精思 (→ idea)
zh_cn.text: 返回一个空理型。

en_us.title: Plato Meditation (→ idea)
en_us.text: Returns an empty idea.

zh_cn.title: 守护序列之精思 (→ list)
zh_cn.text: 此图案返回一个特殊的图案列表，该列表在赫尔墨斯之策略后仍保持不变，也许这会有一些好的用途。

en_us.title: Guardian Sequence Meditation (→ list)
en_us.text: This pattern returns a special pattern list that remains itself after a Hermes Strategy, perhaps this will have some good use.

zh_cn.title: 蒂迈欧之眼光 (vec, idea →)
zh_cn.text: 根据给定理型在目标位置召唤具有理型属性的活体实体。消耗（最大生命值*10 + 速度*1000 + 攻击*100 + 护甲*50）紫水晶粉加上1枚充能紫水晶的媒质。

en_us.title: Timaeus Magic (vec, idea →)
en_us.text: Summons a living entity at the target position based on the given idea, with attributes from the idea. Consumes (max health * 10 + speed * 1000 + attack * 100 + armor * 50) amethyst dust, minimum 1 charged amethyst.

zh_cn.title: 阿波罗之策略 (any →)
zh_cn.text: 把一个Iota当做事故抛出，如果这个事故被捕获，则把那个iota压入栈顶

en_us.title: Apollo's Gambit (any →)
en_us.text: Throws a given iota as a mishap. If the mishap is caught, that iota is pushed onto the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 明辨之纯化 (any → type_iota)
zh_cn.text: 获取栈顶 iota 的类型，以一个 TypeIota 形式返回，所谓的TypeIota，就是一种储存各种类型信息的Iota

en_us.title: Discerning Meditation (any → type_iota)
en_us.text: Reveals the type of the topmost iota, returning it as a TypeIota.

zh_cn.title: 除法之馏化，第二型 (mat, mat → mat)
zh_cn.text: 将第一个 n×m 矩阵中各元素与另一个 n×m 矩阵中相应元素相除。

en_us.title: Division Dstl. II (mat, mat → mat)
en_us.text: Divides the first n by m matrix elementwise by another n by m matrix.

zh_cn.title: 乘法之馏化，第二型 (mat, mat → mat)
zh_cn.text: 将第一个 n×m 矩阵中各元素与另一个 n×m 矩阵中相应元素相乘。

en_us.title: Multiplicative Dstl. II (mat, mat → mat)
en_us.text: Multiplies the first n by m matrix elementwise with another n by m matrix.

zh_cn.title: 乘方之馏化，第二型 (mat, mat → mat)
zh_cn.text: 计算第一个 n×m 矩阵中各元素为底数，另一个 n×m 矩阵中相应元素为指数的幂矩阵。

en_us.title: Power Distillation II (mat, mat → mat)
en_us.text: Raises the first n by m matrix elementwise to the power of another n by m matrix.

zh_cn.title: 实体之馏化：类型 (entitytype, pos → entity | null)
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取实体类型和位置向量，返回该位置符合该类型的实体（若有）。

en_us.title: Entity Distillation: Type (entitytype, pos → entity | null)
en_us.text: Remove an entity type and a position from the stack, and returns an entity of that type at that position if one exists.

zh_cn.title: 收集者之馏化 (vector, vector → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶位置向量和面向量，并返回与该位置处方块对应面交互时可获得的物品类型列表（若面向量为零向量则检索所有面）。

en_us.title: Collector's Distillation (vector, vector → list)
en_us.text: Removes two vectors from the stack representing position and side. Returns a list of Items in the block at the given position accessible from the given side (or all if second vector is zero).

zh_cn.title: 囤积者之馏化 (vector, vector → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶位置向量和面向量，并返回与该位置处方块对应面交互时可获得的物品组列表（若面向量为零向量则检索所有面）。

en_us.title: Hoarder's Distillation (vector, vector → list)
en_us.text: Removes two vectors from the stack representing position and side. Returns a list of Item Stacks in the block at the given position accessible from the given side (or all if second vector is zero).

zh_cn.title: 决斗士之纯化 (entity → item stack)
zh_cn.text: 接受栈顶实体，返回其主手中的物品组。对物品展示框和物品实体同样有效。

en_us.title: Duelist's Purification (entity → item stack)
en_us.text: Transforms the entity at the top of the stack into the Item Stack in its main hand. Also works on Item Frames and dropped items.

zh_cn.title: 司库之馏化 (itemtype|item stack, int → item stack)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶数，再移除此时栈顶的物品类型或物品组，并以所指定的物品和数创建新物品组。

en_us.title: Treasurer's Distillation (itemtype|item stack, int → item stack)
en_us.text: Removes a number and either an itemtype or an Item Stack from the stack, then creates a new Item Stack with the specified item and size.

zh_cn.title: 持盾士之纯化 (entity → item stack)
zh_cn.text: 接受栈顶实体，返回其副手中的物品组。

en_us.title: Shieldbearer's Purification (entity → item stack)
en_us.text: Transforms the entity at the top of the stack into the Item Stack in its off hand.

zh_cn.title: 横拼之馏化 (mat, mat → mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 n×m 矩阵与一个 n×p 矩阵，返回一个 n×(m+p) 矩阵，其中第一个矩阵位于第二个矩阵左方。

en_us.title: Sprawling Distillation (mat, mat → mat)
en_us.text: Accepts an n by m matrix and an n by p matrix and produces an n by (m+p) matrix by putting the first matrix to the left of the second.

zh_cn.title: 纵接之馏化 (mat, mat → mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 m×n 矩阵与一个 p×n 矩阵，返回一个 (m+p)×n 矩阵，其中第一个矩阵位于第二个矩阵上方。

en_us.title: Tower Distillation (mat, mat → mat)
en_us.text: Accepts an n by m matrix and a p by m matrix and produces a (n+p) by m matrix by putting the first matrix on top of the second.

zh_cn.title: 行列式之纯化 (mat → num)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个方阵并返回其行列式。

en_us.title: Determinant Purification (mat → num)
en_us.text: Accepts a square matrix and returns the determinant of that matrix.

zh_cn.title: 单位阵之纯化 (int ≥ 0 → mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个正整数 n，返回 n 阶单位矩阵（即主对角线处为 1，其余各处为 0 的方阵）。

en_us.title: Identity Purification (int ≥ 0 → mat)
en_us.text: Accepts a positive integer n, and returns an n by n matrix with 1 along the diagonal and 0 elsewhere.

zh_cn.title: 逆阵之纯化 (mat → mat)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个任意形状的矩阵，返回其逆。对于行列式不为 0 的方阵，其逆满足：原方阵*逆 = 单位阵。
对于非方阵或行列式为 0 的方阵，此图案会计算其伪逆：即满足原矩阵*伪逆*原矩阵 = 原矩阵，伪逆*原矩阵*伪逆 = 伪逆，且原矩阵*伪逆和伪逆*原矩阵均为对称阵的矩阵。
有关伪逆矩阵的更多信息见下方链接。

en_us.title: Inverse Purification (mat → mat)
en_us.text:
Accepts a matrix of any shappe and returns its inverse. For square matrices with a nonzero determinant, the inverse is the matrix such that in*out = identity.
For non-square matrices or those with a determinant of 0, this pattern computes the pseudoinverse: the matrix such that in*out*in = in, out*in*out = out, and both in*out and out*in are symmetrical.
For more information on the pseudoinverse, see the link below.

zh_cn.title: 组阵之纯化 (num | vec | list → mat)
zh_cn.text:
将栈顶元素转换为矩阵。接受数、向量和列表。
若该 iota 为数，其将变为 1×1 的矩阵。若该 iota 为向量，其将变为 3×1 的矩阵。若该 iota 为列表，则其需为一完全由数组成，或完全由向量组成，或完全由仅含数的列表（所有列表需等长）组成的列表。若组成元素为数，其将变为 1×n 的矩阵；若组成元素为向量，其将变为 3×n 的矩阵；若组成元素为列表，则变为 n×m 的矩阵，其中 n 为内层列表长度，m 为外层列表长度（即内层的每个列表都变为一列）。

en_us.title: Transformation Prfct. (num | vec | list → mat)
en_us.text:
Converts the iota on top of the stack into a matrix. This iota can be a number, vector, or list.
If it is a number, it becomes a 1x1 matrix. If it's a vector, it becomes a 3x1 matrix. If it's a list, it must be a list of purely numbers, purely vectors, or purely lists of numbers (each of which must be the same length). If it's a list of numbers it'll be 1 by n, if it's a list of vectors it'll be 3 by n, and if it's a list of lists it'll be n by m, where n is the inner list length and m is the outer list length (each inner list becomes a column).

zh_cn.title: 旋转阵之馏化 (vec, num → mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受向量 v 与数 θ，返回对应以 v 为轴正向旋转 θ 弧度的旋转矩阵。

en_us.title: Rotation Distillation (vec, num → mat)
en_us.text: Accepts a vec v and number θ, and returns a matrix representing rotating by θ radians around v.

zh_cn.title: 有丝分裂之策略 (mat, num → mat, mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 n×m 矩阵与一个 0 到 m 间的整数，返回由原矩阵在所给整数列处左右分割所得的两个矩阵。

en_us.title: Mitosis Gambit (mat, num → mat, mat)
en_us.text: Accepts an n by m matrix and an int from 0 to m, and returns two matrices created by splitting the input matrix horizontally at the inputted int.

zh_cn.title: 倒坠之策略 (mat, num → mat, mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 n×m 矩阵与一个 0 到 n 间的整数，返回由原矩阵在所给整数行处上下分割所得的两个矩阵。

en_us.title: Toppling Gambit (mat, num → mat, mat)
en_us.text: Accepts an n by m matrix and an int from 0 to n, and returns two matrices created by splitting the input matrix vertically at the inputted int.

zh_cn.title: 解阵之纯化 (mat → num | vec | list)
zh_cn.text:
将栈顶矩阵依其长宽转换为数、向量或列表。
1×1 矩阵会变成数。1×3 或 3×1 矩阵会变成向量。3×n 或 n×3 矩阵会变成由向量组成的列表。所有其余矩阵会变成由仅含数的列表组成的列表，内层列表长度为矩阵列数。

en_us.title: Restoration Prfct. (mat → num | vec | list)
en_us.text:
Converts the iota on top of the stack back from a matrix into a number, vector, or list depending on the vector's size.
A 1x1 matrix will become a number. A 1x3 or 3x1 matrix will become a vector. A 3 by n or n by 3 matrix will become a list of vectors, and any matrix not covered by the previous will become a list of lists of numbers, with each inner list being one column of the matrix.

zh_cn.title: 解阵之纯化，第二型 (mat → [[num]])
zh_cn.text: 与 解阵之纯化 类似，但此图案只会返回由仅含数的列表组成的列表。

en_us.title: Restoration Prfct. II (mat → [[num]])
en_us.text: As Restoration Purification , except it always returns a list of lists of numbers.

zh_cn.title: 零阵之馏化 (int ≥ 0, int ≥ 0 → mat)
zh_cn.text: 接受两个正整数 n 和 m，返回 n×m 的零矩阵（即处处为 0 的矩阵）。

en_us.title: Zero Distillation (int ≥ 0, int ≥ 0 → mat)
en_us.text: Accepts positive integers n and m, and returns an n by m matrix of zeros.

zh_cn.title: 图案师之纯化 (pattern → str | null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶图案转换为其名字。如果该图案不对应任何操作，或对应的操作是卓越法术，则返回 Null。

en_us.title: Patternmaster's Prfct. (pattern → str | null)
en_us.text: Converts the pattern on top of the stack into the string for that pattern's name. If there is no action associated with that pattern, or if the associated pattern is a Great Spell, it returns null.

zh_cn.title: 读者之纯化 (vec → str | [str])
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶向量，若该向量坐标处有一告示牌或讲台，返回其上文本。否则返回 Null。

en_us.title: Reader's Purification (vec → str | [str])
en_us.text: Removes a vector from the stack. If that vector is pointing at a sign or lectern, it returns that sign or lectern's text to the stack. Otherwise, it returns null.

zh_cn.title: 书写 (vec, str | [str] →)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶向量和字符串。若该向量坐标处有一告示牌或讲台，则会将所给字符串写至其上。消耗 1/100 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Write (vec, str | [str] →)
en_us.text: Removes a vector and a string from the stack. If that vector is pointing at a sign or lectern, it writes that string to that sign or lectern. Costs a hundredth of an Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 大小写之馏化 (str, bool | null → str)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈顶字符串和布尔值（Null 也可）。若为 True，将字符串改为全大写并返回；若为 False，则改为全小写；若为 Null，则切换所有字符的大小写。

en_us.title: Case Distillation (str, bool | null → str)
en_us.text:
Removes a string and a bool or null. If it was true, return the string in upper case. If false, lowercase. If null, toggle each character's case.

zh_cn.title: 听者之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 将任何人发至聊天框的最后一条消息作为字符串压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Listener's Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Adds the last message anyone sent to the stack as a string.

zh_cn.title: 耳语之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 将施法者发至聊天框的最后一条消息作为字符串压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Whisper Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Adds the last message the caster sent to the stack as a string.

zh_cn.title: 筛具之精思 (→ str | null)
zh_cn.text: 返回上一次传给 筛具之策略 的字符串。

en_us.title: Sifter's Reflection (→ str | null)
en_us.text: Returns the last string you passed to Sifter's Gambit .

zh_cn.title: 筛具之策略 (str | null →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个字符串。所有此后发出的以此字符串起始的消息将不再对他人可见。同时， 耳语之精思 也将只能读取上述消息。

en_us.title: Sifter's Gambit (str | null →)
en_us.text: Accepts a string; All future chat messages starting with that string won't be seen by others, and only messages prefixed with that string can be read by Whisper Reflection .

zh_cn.title: 逗点之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个仅含单个半角逗号的字符串。其在连接其他字符串方面十分有用。

en_us.title: Comma Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Add a comma string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

zh_cn.title: 空串之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个空字符串。其在连接其他字符串方面十分有用。

en_us.title: Blank Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Add an empty string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

zh_cn.title: 代笔人之纯化 (any → str)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶元素转换为字符串。

en_us.title: Scrivener's Purification (any → str)
en_us.text: Converts the iota on top of the stack into a string.

zh_cn.title: 名号之纯化 (entity → str)
zh_cn.text: 接受栈顶实体，并返回其名称。若为物品实体，则返回物品的名称。

en_us.title: Moniker Purification (entity → str)
en_us.text: Takes an entity and returns that entity's name. If it is an item entity, return the item's name.

zh_cn.title: 命名 (str, entity →)
zh_cn.text: 接受栈顶字符串和实体，并将该实体的名称设定为该字符串。若为物品实体，则会同时更改物品的名称。消耗 1/100 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Name (str, entity →)
en_us.text: Takes a string and an entity, and sets that entities name to the given string. If the entity is an item entity, also set the item's name. Costs a hundredth of an Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 断句之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个仅含单个换行符的字符串。其在连接其他字符串方面十分有用。

en_us.title: Breaking Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Add a string to the stack representing a break between lines, useful for combining with other strings.

zh_cn.title: 输入之纯化 (str → num | null)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶字符串，并返回字符串所解析得的数（若无法解析则返回 Null）。

en_us.title: Input Purification (str → num | null)
en_us.text: Removes a string from the top of the stack and returns the number that string parses as (or null if it doesn't parse).

zh_cn.title: 空格之精思 (→ str)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个仅含单个空格的字符串。其在连接其他字符串方面十分有用。

en_us.title: Spacing Reflection (→ str)
en_us.text: Add a blank space string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

zh_cn.title: 分串之馏化 (str, str → [str])
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶两字符串，并以第二个字符串为分隔符拆分第一个字符串，结果作为列表返回。

en_us.title: Separation Distillation (str, str → [str])
en_us.text: Removes the top two strings from the stack and splits the first string, using the second string as the delimiter and returning as a list.

zh_cn.title: 内科医师之纯化 (entity → entitytype)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶实体，并返回该实体的类型。

en_us.title: Physician's Purification (entity → entitytype)
en_us.text: Remove an entity from the stack, and adds the type of the entity at that location to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 分类学家之纯化 (any → iotatype)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素，并返回该 iota 的类型。

en_us.title: Classifier's Purification (any → iotatype)
en_us.text: Remove an iota from the stack, and adds the type of that iota to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 分拣员之精思 (→ itemtype)
zh_cn.text: 若施法者副手中有物品，则将其类型压入栈顶；若无，则压入施法用手中物品的类型。

en_us.title: Sorter's Reflection (→ itemtype)
en_us.text: Adds the type of the item in the caster's offhand to the stack if there is one present, or the type of the casting hand otherwise.

zh_cn.title: 分拣员之纯化 (itemtypable → itemtype)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶位置向量，物品实体或物品展示框。并返回该处方块的类型或对应物品类型。（如草方块、石头、木棍等。）

en_us.title: Sorter's Purification (itemtypable → itemtype)
en_us.text: Remove an iota with an associated item type (for example a location and the type of the block at that location, an item entity, or an item frame) from the stack and returns the item type to the stack (e.g. Grass, Stone, Stick, etc.).

zh_cn.title: 区域之提整：非类型 (entitytype, pos, num → [entity])
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取实体类型、位置向量及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有不符合给定类型的实体的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Exaltation: Not-Type (entitytype, pos, num → [entity])
en_us.text: Remove an entity type, a position, and a radius from the stack, and returns a list of all entities not of that type within that radius of that position

zh_cn.title: 区域之提整：类型 (entitytype, pos, num → [entity])
zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取实体类型、位置向量及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有符合给定类型的实体的列表。

en_us.title: Zone Exaltation: Type (entitytype, pos, num → [entity])
en_us.text: Remove an entity type, a position, and a radius from the stack, and returns a list of all entities of that type within that radius of that position.

zh_cn.title: 扬升共振 (entity →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个活体，在 1 分钟内即可在世界各处访问所给活体。基础消耗 1 个紫水晶碎片，在效应消退前每施放一次额外消耗 1 个紫水晶碎片。
这种效果的原理似乎是让目标散发出某种超自然共振。这种共振相当强大，目标的轮廓隔着各种形式的障碍依然“可见”。（咒术师们也许就在持续产生这种共振，只不过是没有如此效果显著？）但是，这种辉光与光灵箭等造成的辉光不一样，不要指望监测那种辉光的仪器对这种也有效。

en_us.title: Uplifting Resonance (entity →)
en_us.text:
Accepts a living entity, and allows it to be accessed from anywhere for one minute. Has a base cost of one amethyst shard, plus one additional shard per application before allowing it to expire.
It seems that this effect functions by causing the target to emit some sort of psionic resonance, strong enough to cause its outline to be visible through all manner of barriers (perhaps hexcasters naturally produce this same resonance, but much subtler?). However, this glow is distinct from that induced by spectral arrows and similar, so don't bet on things to detect that working for this.
