zh_cn.title: 辨察遮罩 (vector, number → [vector])
zh_cn.text: 接受一个向量和一个数，并返回以所给位置为起始，指向范围内带有遮罩的实体的单位向量列表，侦测半径为所给数。

en_us.title: Discern Shroud (vector, number → [vector])
en_us.text: Accepts a vector and a number, and returns a list of unit vectors pointing from the initial vector to shrouded entities within a radius defined by the number.

zh_cn.title: 智识门径 (Entity, Imprint →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个实体和一个空间印记，将所给实体传送入对应维度的同一位置。消耗 20 个充能紫水晶。
传入其他玩家时会失效。
如果在离开原先所处维度的同一时刻，用此法术返回该维度，则消耗会减少到 5 个紫水晶粉：法术会捕捉残存的媒质以将我传送回原来的位置。其他情况下，则会在目的地周围找个安全的位置作为目的地，甚至有可能构筑方块以防止坠落而亡。
我在用这个法术时总有种奇怪的加速感，但我无法理解加速度到底是朝着哪个轴的。

en_us.title: Noetic Gateway (Entity, Imprint →)
en_us.text:
Accepts an entity and a Spatial Imprint and teleports the entity to its position in the proper dimension. Generally costs 20 Charged Amethyst. Will fail if supplied a player other than myself.
If I use this to return to a dimension that I previously left within the same instant, the cost drops to five amethyst dust, as the spell can take advantage of a lingering strand of media leading back to my original position. Otherwise, it will attempt to find a safe spot to deposit me, potentially conjuring a block to prevent me from falling to my doom.
Strangely, I feel an odd sense of acceleration when transporting myself this way, along some incomprehensible axis.

zh_cn.title: 空间之精思 (→ Imprint)
zh_cn.text: 返回象征着我所处维度的空间印记。消耗极少量媒质。

en_us.title: Spatial Reflection (→ Imprint)
en_us.text: Returns a Spatial Imprint representing the dimension I am currently in. Costs a negligible amount of media.

zh_cn.title: 空间之精思，第二型 (→ Imprint | NULL)
zh_cn.text: 返回象征着我哨卫所处维度的空间印记。消耗 1/10 个紫水晶粉。

en_us.title: Spatial Reflection II (→ Imprint | NULL)
en_us.text: Returns a Spatial Imprint representing the dimension my sentinel is currently in. Costs one-tenth of an amethyst dust.

zh_cn.title: 阿特拉斯之分解 (Imprint → num, num)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个空间印记，返回对应维度中可存在方块的最低和最高海拔。

en_us.title: Atlas' Decomposition (Imprint → num, num)
en_us.text: Accepts a Spatial Imprint, and returns the lowest and highest altitudes at which blocks can exist in the corresponding dimension.

zh_cn.title: 空程之纯化 (Imprint → num)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个空间印记，返回对应维度中1格距离相当于主世界中的几格距离。

en_us.title: Ratio Purification (Imprint → num)
en_us.text: Accepts a Spatial Imprint, and returns how many blocks you'd have to travel in the overworld to travel the equivalent of one block in the input dimension.

zh_cn.title: 媒质灌注 (Vector →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个向量，并向该位置方块中注入媒质，以嬗变该方块。消耗量与具体效果随目标变化而变。
概念上来看，此法术与 启迪树苗 类似。 然而，这种方法灌注的媒质相较之下经过精细调校，因此能产生更为有意思的效果。

en_us.title: Media Infusion (Vector →)
en_us.text:
Accepts a vector and infuses media into the corresponding block in order to transmute it. Cost and exact effect vary depending on target.
Conceptually, this spell is quite similar to Edify Sapling . However, the media that the target block receives is far more finely-tuned, and can thus achieve far more interesting results.

zh_cn.title: 收回Iota (key → any)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个有效键，并返回相应 iota。消耗大约 1/4 个紫水晶粉。

en_us.title: Retrieve Iota (key → any)
en_us.text: Accepts a valid key, and returns the corresponding iota. Costs one-eigth of an amethyst dust.

zh_cn.title: 元数据之纯化 (key → number)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个有效键, 并返回刻印对应 iota 的时间，或是返回 -1。不消耗媒质。

en_us.title: Metadata Purification (key → number)
en_us.text: Accepts a valid key, and returns when the corresponding iota was inscribed, or -1. Costs no media.

zh_cn.title: 元数据之馏化 (key, player → bool)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个有效键和一个代表玩家的 iota，并检验对应 iota 是否由所给玩家刻印。不消耗媒质。
我已进入过智识界的深处，也据此设计了可控再现其中侵解效应的方法。这种效应能将实体拆成信息，然后便可将其导入智识界，操作方法和刻印 iota 类似。若再提取信息，即可按原样将实体重组出来。不过，虽然所得信息的密度远大于普通 iota，但这些实体的消解速度却和后者没有区别。而且，它们似乎具备某种抗覆写性质，如若覆写便会立刻重组。
当然，不是所有实体都能被存储。试图存储不适用的实体会招致事故。
按读取普通 iota 的方式读取实体，会返回实体的类型；而试图按释放实体的方式释放 iota，产生的便是一只游走咒灵，其颜色和 iota 的颜色相近。试图对空键释放实体会产生一只颜色随机的咒灵。

en_us.title: Metadata Distillation (key, player → bool)
en_us.text:
Accepts a valid key and a player, and returns whether the corresponding iota was inscribed by that player. Costs no media.
Now that I've experienced a deeper portion of the noosphere, I've devised a way to recreate its disintegration effects in a more controlled manner, breaking entities down into information, which I can direct into the noosphere in a way similar to inscribing iotas. I can later extract this information to reconstitute the entities exactly as they were. Despite the far greater information density, stored entities will decay just as quickly as iotas. Furthermore, they are somewhat resistant to being overwritten, and are automatically released instead.
Of course, not all entities can be stored, and attempting to store such an entity will cause the spell to mishap.
Attempting to read an entity entry as if it were an iota will simply return the type of the entity, and attempting to release an entity from an iota entry will create a wandering wisp with a color similar to the iota. Attempting to release an entity where there is no entry at all creates a wisp with a random color.

zh_cn.title: 隐匿遮罩 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个生物和一个数，并给予该实体持续所给数秒的咒术侦测护盾。每秒持续时间消耗 2 个紫水晶粉。
同时每秒会消耗所影响实体 1/10 个紫水晶粉，护盾的构筑需要这些媒质。
我需要注意我把这种效果给予了什么事物，因为没有携带其他媒质来源的生物会消耗自身的意识来供给护盾。
这种护盾在阻挡 侦查员之馏化 和各种 区域之馏化 时效果良好，但它对 实体之纯化 的变种没有作用，那些操作已经包含所处位置的精确概念。而且，这层糠皮自身也有能量特征，尽管暗淡，依然可用特种图案侦测。

en_us.title: Stealth Shroud (entity, number →)
en_us.text:
Accepts a living entity and a number ( n ), and shields the entity from hex-based detection for n seconds. Costs two amethyst dust per second.
Also drains media from the entity at a rate of 1/10 of a dust per second, as the shielding effect collects it to produce the chaff.
I should be careful with what I apply this to, as creatures with no loose media of their own will have their very minds fractured in order to provide this media.
While this is very effective at blocking effects such as Scout's Distillation and the various forms of Zone Distillation , it has no effect on Entity Purification variants, as those already have a fairly precise idea of where you are. What's more, the chaff itself produces an energy signautre, which, while dim, is detectable by a specialized pattern.

zh_cn.title: 空间互换 ([vec, vec], [vec, vec], Imprint →)
zh_cn.text:
接受均由两个向量组成的两个列表，用于定义两个长方体，以及一个空间印记。所定义的长方体必须保证尺寸与朝向一致。
我不太清楚这个图案具体能做什么，它总是对我喊着什么“特殊维度”。也许它需要这种特殊维度作为中介？
将我所处维度中第一个长方体包含的方块（需在影响范围内）与空间印记对应维度中第二个长方体包含的方块互换。 消耗以紫水晶粉计，前 1001 个方块遵循对数消耗，之后则按照线性关系增加 。 不会互换不可破坏的方块。 两维度之一或两者均需为智识界。

en_us.title: Spatial Interchange ([vec, vec], [vec, vec], Imprint →)
en_us.text:
Accepts two lists of two vectors, to define two cuboids, and a Spatial Imprint. These cuboids must have the exact same dimensions and rotation.
I'm not quite sure what this one is supposed to do, it's always yelling at me about special dimensions. Perhaps it needs to use this special dimension as an intermediary?
Exchanges the blocks within the first cuboid in your current dimension (which must be within ambit) for the blocks within the second cuboid in the dimension corresponding to the Spatial Imprint. Cost (in amethyst dust) is logarithmic for the first 1001 blocks, after which it increases linearly . Will not exchange any unbreakable blocks. One or both of the endpoint dimensions must be the noosphere.

zh_cn.title: 刻印Iota (key, any →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个有效键以及任意 iota，并将所给 iota 存入相应位置。消耗大约 1/4 个紫水晶粉。

en_us.title: Inscribe Iota (key, any →)
en_us.text: Accepts a valid key and any iota, and stores it in the corresponding location. Costs a quarter of an amethyst dust.
